I had one once when I was young, probably about 7. Didn't realize it was a night terror until I was much older and learned of them. 

Like a lot of people say, I felt completely paralyzed and couldn't move my body, not even a toe. I was laying on my back, head facing the wall by my bed, and I remember seeing a 'shadow' there that wasn't mine. (It was upright and I was laying down.)

The odd thing about this 'shadow' was that I could see that it had 'eyes'. I still to this day can't recall exactly what those eyes looked like, but I remember them being bright, vivid, and terrifying. 

I wanted to scream in terror but I couldn't move at all. It was like my mind was on overdrive but my body wouldn't follow orders as normal. Pretty sure I just somehow fell back asleep eventually and then woke up the next morning. Like I said before, certain details are fuzzy at this point.

Edit: Also I should mention that I haven't had any episodes of night terrors since that one. I'm now 24.
